satisfied.scenario: Successful product purchase with a valid credit card
satisfied.steps: 1. Register a new user. 2. Add a product to the cart. 3. Proceed to checkout. 4. Enter valid credit card details. 5. Complete the purchase.
satisfied.expected: Order is placed successfully, and order confirmation is received.  Product is removed from cart.

satisfied.scenario: Failed product purchase with an invalid credit card number
satisfied.steps: 1. Register a new user. 2. Add a product to the cart. 3. Proceed to checkout. 4. Enter an invalid credit card number. 5. Attempt to complete the purchase.
satisfied.expected: Purchase fails with an appropriate error message indicating invalid credit card details.

satisfied.scenario: Failed product purchase with expired credit card
satisfied.steps: 1. Register a new user. 2. Add a product to the cart. 3. Proceed to checkout. 4. Enter an expired credit card. 5. Attempt to complete the purchase.
satisfied.expected: Purchase fails with an appropriate error message indicating an expired credit card.

satisfied.scenario: Failed purchase attempt with insufficient funds
satisfied.steps: 1. Register a new user. 2. Add a product to the cart. 3. Proceed to checkout. 4. Use a card with insufficient funds. 5. Attempt to complete the purchase.
satisfied.expected: Purchase fails with an error message indicating insufficient funds.

satisfied.scenario: Purchase attempt with a very large order exceeding a hypothetical limit
satisfied.steps: 1. Register a new user. 2. Add a large quantity of a single high-priced product to the cart. 3. Proceed to checkout and attempt to purchase.
satisfied.expected: Purchase may fail due to exceeding a potential order limit or raise a relevant error. (This is an edge case dependent on whether the backend has any such limit implemented.)

satisfied.scenario: Purchase with a zero-priced product (edge case)
satisfied.steps: 1. Register a new user. 2. Add a product with a price of 0 to the cart. 3. Proceed to checkout and complete the purchase.
satisfied.expected: The order should be processed successfully, even with a price of 0.  This tests handling of edge case values.

not_satisfied.scenario: Attempt to purchase without being logged in
not_satisfied.steps: 1. Add a product to the cart. 2. Proceed to checkout without logging in.
not_satisfied.expected: User is redirected to the login page or receives an error message indicating the need for authentication.
